zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Ridgewood Village Center, Residential & Parkway Districts
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.782%, with an equalization ratio of 76.5%.
Public education represents 66.8% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 23.4%.
Average residential assessment is $734,400, producing an average annual tax bill of $20,431.01.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Ridgewood Village, homeowners pay an average of $20,431.01 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.5% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 76.5%, assessed values average ~76.5% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 66.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 23.4%, and Bergen County claims 9.8%.
